title: A Trip to Spain
setting: A trip from a home in China to a sunny beach town in Spain.

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper)

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan)

sentences.en: Dan and Anna wake up early at home.
sentences.zh: 丹和安娜一大早在家醒来。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) and Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) wake up in bed, packed suitcases by the door, dawn at the window.
sentences.narration: Dan and Anna wake up in bed, packed suitcases by the door, dawn at the window.

sentence_targets.en: to stop sleeping, or make someone stop sleeping

sentences.en: They take a taxi to the airport quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们赶紧坐出租车去机场。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) and Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) jump into a yellow taxi with their suitcases.
sentences.narration: Dan and Anna jump into a yellow taxi with their suitcases.

sentence_targets.en: At a fast speed or after only a short time.
A car with a driver whom you pay for a journey.

sentences.en: Anna holds their airplane tickets in her hand.
sentences.zh: 安娜手里拿着他们的机票。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) holds two plane tickets at an airport, an airplane outside the big window.
sentences.narration: Anna holds two plane tickets at an airport, an airplane outside the big window.

sentence_targets.en: A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings.
A paper or electronic pass allowing travel or entry.

sentences.en: They fly from China to Spain.
sentences.zh: 他们从中国飞往西班牙。
sentences.scene_prompt: An airplane flies high above the clouds, leaving a land of green hills and pagodas behind and heading toward a sunny coast with white houses and orange roofs.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the plane flying from an Asian landscape toward a sunny coast; the country names can't be shown.
sentences.narration: An airplane flies high above the clouds, leaving a land of green hills and pagodas behind and heading toward a sunny coast with white houses and orange roofs.

sentence_targets.en: showing where someone or something starts or originates
to move through the air using wings

sentences.en: A bus drives them along a sunny road.
sentences.zh: 一辆公共汽车载着他们沿着阳光明媚的道路行驶。
sentences.scene_prompt: A bus drives along a sunny coast road; Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) and Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) look out of its window.
sentences.narration: A bus drives along a sunny coast road. Dan and Anna look out of its window.

sentence_targets.en: a large road vehicle that carries passengers
to control a vehicle and make it move
a hard surface built for vehicles to travel along

sentences.en: Dan looks at a map to find their hotel.
sentences.zh: 丹看地图找他们的酒店。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) studies a paper map on a street corner while Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) points the way.
sentences.narration: Dan studies a paper map on a street corner while Anna points the way.

sentence_targets.en: A drawing showing where places or features are located

sentences.en: They stay at a small hotel near the beach.
sentences.zh: 他们住在海滩附近的一家小酒店。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) and Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) stand on the balcony of a small white hotel above a sandy beach.
sentences.narration: Dan and Anna stand on the balcony of a small white hotel above a sandy beach.

sentence_targets.en: To remain in a place or live somewhere temporarily.
an area of sand or small stones beside water

sentences.en: Every morning they ride bikes by the sea.
sentences.zh: 每天早上他们在海边骑自行车。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) and Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) ride bicycles along the seaside in the morning sun.
sentences.draw_note: Shows them riding bikes by the sea in the morning; 'every' can't be shown.
sentences.narration: Dan and Anna ride bicycles along the seaside in the morning sun.

sentence_targets.en: To travel on a bicycle, animal, or vehicle.
a bicycle or, informally, a motorcycle
